# scripts/Showcase/IntruderBrain.gd

[Source:1](../../../../../scripts/Showcase/IntruderBrain.gd#L1)

Declarations come from source. Unannotated types are explicit; see the [system guides](../../../../systems/README.md) for runtime schemas, nullability, ownership, units and side effects.

Director-driven intruder verbs: walk/run/sneak, hide, backstab, fight, flee, face, and stand.
Fighting tactics are trade, turtle, parry, focus, press, and spare; guard AI remains autonomous.
Reaction runs before combat movement; locomotion runs only if combat did not consume the movement step.
Never deliberately attacks a kneeling mercy target.

Base: `RefCounted`. Registered class: `none`.

- `enum Verb { NONE, GO, HIDE, STAB, FIGHT, FLEE }` — [Source:83](../../../../../scripts/Showcase/IntruderBrain.gd#L83)
